text: Day 38 of #100DaysOfCode. Today I learned why an AI step should return JSON, not prose: my code can check JSON, and it can't check a paragraph. One Zod schema now gives me both the TypeScript type and the runtime check.

Day 37. Finished an n8n workflow that sorts my inbox into recruiter, interview, course and newsletter mail, and saves reply drafts for recruiters. It never sends anything on its own: I read the draft and press Send myself.
Day 36. Rebuilt my LinkedIn poster in TypeScript after building it in n8n. The visual version was faster to start; the code version is easier to test and to put in git.
